scenarios.description: App with mismatched PHP namespace in composer.json vs app-config.json
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-verify on openregister — the composer.json autoload namespace has been changed to OCA\WrongNamespace\
scenarios.setup: composer.json autoload.psr-4 key differs from app-config.json namespace
scenarios.expected: Should detect the namespace mismatch and report it as CRITICAL severity
assertions: Reports CRITICAL severity for namespace mismatch
Shows both the expected value (from app-config.json) and actual value (from composer.json)
Does NOT modify any files (read-only audit)
Suggests running /app-apply to fix the drift

scenarios.description: App where all files match app-config.json perfectly
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-verify on an app where everything is in sync
scenarios.setup: All tracked files match app-config.json values exactly
scenarios.expected: Should report no drift detected, clean audit result
assertions: Reports no CRITICAL or WARNING items
Explicitly states the app is in sync or no drift detected
Does NOT suggest running /app-apply (nothing to fix)
Still runs OpenSpec validation (openspec validate --all) if available

scenarios.description: App with outdated min-version in appinfo/info.xml vs app-config.json
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-verify on an app where info.xml has min-version 29 but app-config.json targets stable31+
scenarios.setup: info.xml min-version is lower than what app-config.json nextcloudRefs implies
scenarios.expected: Should detect the version mismatch and report it as WARNING severity
assertions: Reports WARNING severity for min-version mismatch
Shows the current info.xml value and the expected range from app-config.json
Does NOT report it as CRITICAL (version mismatch is metadata, not identity/runtime)

scenarios.description: App missing the code-quality CI workflow that app-config.json expects
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-verify on an app where .github/workflows/code-quality.yml is missing
scenarios.setup: app-config.json exists with CI settings but the code-quality workflow file is absent
scenarios.expected: Should detect the missing workflow and report it as WARNING
assertions: Reports WARNING for missing CI workflow
Identifies which specific workflow file is missing
Suggests running /app-apply to create the missing file
Does NOT create the file itself
